Navigation Fixture A

Fixture A content for navigation persistence.

AURA_NAV_MARKER_A_BEFORE_NAVIGATION

This first navigation fixture contains a realistic block of article text so SmartScope can select a stable content root before navigation. The mode should apply to this readable region, record scoped CSS, and keep the active state available for rehydration when the tab moves to another page on the same origin.

The additional prose is deliberate test data. It gives the scoped mode engine enough text length and paragraph density to avoid falling back to no scope, while keeping the page small and deterministic for local Playwright runs.

Scoped mode should survive navigation and reapply to the next document without leaving stale tokens on the old page or broad global styles on the new one.
